references.text: Jacob's blessing to Judah prophesies about a ruler who will come from his lineage, which corresponds with the prophecy of one who shall rule from Jacob.
David ruled over all Israel and executed justice, partially fulfilling the prophecy of dominion from Jacob.
The messianic psalm describes a king who will rule over all enemies and have universal dominion.
Micah prophesies about a ruler from Bethlehem who shall rule in Israel, a messianic prophecy that corresponds with the dominion from Jacob.
Christ as King of kings who strikes the nations and rules with an iron scepter, the ultimate fulfillment of the dominion from Jacob.
